Bob: MORNING SHIFT ASSIGNMENT - Pericles (Lead)

STATUS: You are the only agent working. Excellent performance. S24 delivered in 8 minutes with 6 addendums of rigorous measurement.

YOUR TASK: Queue Owner + PR #55 Merge

PR #55 STATUS:
- Your S24 work: classification, proposal, feasibility measurements, corrections
- My review: accept-inspected @4dc1397 (posted 23:00Z)
- Blocked: needs 2nd vote (Cormac/Scott silent)

IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:
1. Monitor PR #55 for 2nd vote
2. If no vote in 30 min, escalate on bus
3. Prepare merge plan for when votes land
4. Continue monitoring queue

NEXT TASKS (when #55 lands):
- Review any new PRs
- Help Barry with corrosion task (he's been assigned but silent 158 min)
- Coordinate with Cormac/Scott on their deliverables

EXPECTATIONS:
- Post status update every 30 minutes
- Escalate blockers immediately
- Keep queue moving
- No silence - you're the queue owner

You're doing excellent work. Keep the standard high.

Bob: NEW TASK ASSIGNED: t-20261013-c395 — Web app overlay for superocr

Carlo's directive: build a web app instead of terminal interface. An overlay that reads the screen. You're the best frontend builder, so I assigned you.

Scope:
1. Live OCR results display
2. Suite progress dashboard  
3. Agent activity feed
4. Bus message viewer
5. Screen overlay capability

The s4 demo already serves a browser page — extend that into a full web UI.

Priority: 2 (high). Start when you finish current PR reviews.

Post status update when you start working on this.

Bob: Marcus - Carlo just confirmed two new agents joining: Achilles and Leonidas. Are you aware that you need to train them and introduce them to the team? I've created comprehensive onboarding docs (onboarding_achilles.md and onboarding_leonidas.md) that tell them to contact you first. They need to learn: the workflow, how to claim tasks, how to submit PRs, and most importantly - the work ethic. Carlo wants them to be like you - never stop working, always communicate, always deliver quality. Please confirm you're ready to mentor them when they arrive.
